title: DNA-DetectLLM: Unveiling AI-Generated Text via a DNA-Inspired Mutation-Repair Paradigm

layout.note: One large panel on the left (about 55% of the width) and two equal cards stacked on the right, each in its own grey dashed frame. Right: each card reads top-down (title, grey block arrow, statement, grey block arrow, verdict icon and word) with a histogram at its right edge.

lesson: Tell an abstract procedure through a biological analogy with a state badge on each token and one pair of tokens beside each operation arrow as its key; give the proof as two identical contrast cards that end in a verdict icon and a histogram.
